test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

You can always __dependent on me__.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Depend on me**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence contains an error with the word "dependent."
 
• **Dependent **is an **adjective**, while "**depend**" is the **verb **that should be used in this context.
 
• The phrase "**depend on**" means to rely on or trust someone or something.
 
• The preposition "**on**" is the correct one to use in this context.
 
• The correct sentence should convey the idea that the person can rely on or trust the speaker, making "**depend**" the appropriate choice.
 
• The corrected sentence, "*You can always depend on me*," is grammatically accurate and effectively communicates the intended meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
